proof_body:
by
  intro P a b hb h
  have him : ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I).im ≠ 0 := by simpa using hb
  have hd := Polynomial.quadratic_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero_im_ne_zero P h him
  have hre : ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I).re = a := by simp
  have hn : ‖(a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp
    ring
  rwa [hre, hn] at hd
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℝ) (a b : ℝ), b ≠ 0 → Polynomial.aeval ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I) P = 0 → (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (2 * a) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) ∣ P
